title: Rav Chama bar Pappa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sukkah 49b, but the reading of Dikdukei Soferim is Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa, and so it is in Yalkut, Tehillim, 36 and 103.
In Kohelet Rabbah 10:10: Rabbi Chama bar Pappa in the name of Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Sukkah 49b fully writes Rabbi Chama bar Pappa, whereas Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav. The Midrash Rabbah — TE Kohelet 10:10 has Rabbi Chama bar Pappa reporting Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon. The full title difference is retained.

The consulted Sukkah 49b fully titles Chama bar Pappa Rabbi, beside the supplied full Rav heading. Kohelet Rabbah 10:10 has Rabbi Chama bar Pappa reporting Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon. The Chanina reading attributed to Dikdukei Soferim and the two Yalkut references remain Hyman's uncollated reports; neither full title nor patronymic is harmonized.
